purpose: Retain the same-run ADSP PM program-space reads used by $0214-$0237, the routine that builds the DM($0036) record control word latched at $0514. The committed adsp-som-pm-reads-f551 capture retains PM reads for $0147-$0173 only, so the MAC loop's PM($1019)-PM($101E) operands were unavailable and the control word had to stay a measured entry input.

mame.role: stock-behaviour, the same build as adsp-som-pm-reads-f551. Chosen deliberately: AGENTS.md forbids comparing captures across binaries, and this artifact is only meaningful next to the one it extends.

harness.start_condition: power_on with a disposable copy of the recorded NVRAM seed

relation_to_committed_evidence.note: The same transaction with strictly more PM data: identical 146 (address_word, value, pc, seq) words, identical 4009 DM events, identical GINT event, and the earlier 171 PM reads unchanged. The differing whole-file hashes are the added PM rows only.

limits: The PM dwords are operands, not meanings: nothing here says what $0214-$0237 computes with them.
PM($1019)-PM($101E) read the same value on all nine records in this one frame, so the capture cannot separate a mask or shift these particular values do not exercise.
One frame, one transaction. No claim that DM($0036) is $0030 in any other state.
